sentences.en: Just wandering around can be a good way to travel.
sentences.zh: 随便逛逛也可能是很好的旅行方式。

sentences.en: I had some free time, so I wandered around town.
sentences.zh: 我有些空闲时间，就在城里闲逛。

sentences.en: He enjoys wandering around the forest in his spare time.
sentences.zh: 他喜欢在空闲时漫步森林。

senses.zh: 漫游，迷路，离题，徘徊，漫步，闲逛，蜿蜒
